# Mobile UX Brainstorm

## Observed problems

- The fixed Generate overlay collides with the normal-flow Estimated Cost card on phone screens.
- Prompt entry has useful controls but no immediately tappable starter examples.
- Reference controls state limits but do not teach what each media type contributes to H3.
- Text mode shows an empty reference tray that consumes a large card without enough instructional value.
- Mobile hierarchy needs stronger separation between composing, guiding, configuring, and submitting.

## Candidate improvements

- Replace fixed Generate overlay with one unified submission panel containing readiness, cost, details, and Generate.
- Add compact prompt templates for cinematic movement, product shot, character performance, and atmospheric scene.
- Keep Paste prominent beside templates and prompt library.
- Add mode-aware reference instructions: frame anchors, image identity/style, video motion/camera, audio sound/voice.
- Make text mode reference section compact and instructional instead of showing a large empty tray.
- Preserve reusable Library access and current file/URL workflows.
- Test 360px and screenshot-equivalent phone dimensions for overlap and horizontal overflow.
